"We have two accounts and a third waiting outside. Let us hear Mira before we decide what they mean."
Taylor raises a hand to pause the discussion.

"Outside, through the side exit, now. We can hear the report once we are clear of the hall."
Taylor moves toward the open side exit.

"You gave us your word, Ren. Stay a little longer; we can settle the details together instead of abandoning the exercise."
Taylor pulls the gate toward its closed position.

"Then go. I think practice would help, but agreeing to help yesterday was not agreeing to this route."
Taylor steps away from the gate.
